verdict.rationale: The evidence documents the Kimi Code CLI only as an interactive terminal chat started with `kimi` and authenticated via an in-session `/login` command. Nothing documents a non-interactive or headless mode, scripted invocation, or CI integration. The OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible Kimi API is a separate developer building block for constructing automation, not a headless run mode of the product, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
